```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
# ReGround 2035 Scenario Analysis
# Including growth in excavated soil generation

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Baseline assumptions
# ---------------------------------------------------------

base_year <- 2026
target_year <- 2035

# Current Auckland excavated soil
soil_2026 <- 2000000

# Assumed annual growth in excavated soil generation
# This is a modelling assumption based on future
# population and construction growth in Auckland.
soil_growth_rate <- 0.012     # 1.2% per year

# Transport assumptions
landfill_distance <- 92       # km
reuse_distance <- 12          # km

# NZ heavy freight emission factor
emission_factor <- 0.105      # kg CO2-e per tonne-km

# External global benchmark
global_circular_target <- 0.15


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Create annual trend from 2026 to 2035
# ---------------------------------------------------------

trend <- tibble(
  year = base_year:target_year
) %>%
  mutate(
    
    # Number of years after baseline
    years_after_2026 = year - base_year,
    
    # Projected total excavated soil
    total_soil =
      soil_2026 *
      (1 + soil_growth_rate)^years_after_2026,
    
    # ReGround adoption assumption
    # Starts at 1% in 2026 and reaches 10% in 2035
    reground_share =
      seq(
        0.01,
        0.10,
        length.out = n()
      ),
    
    # Soil redirected to local reuse
    reused_soil =
      total_soil *
      reground_share,
    
    # Soil still sent to landfill
    landfill_soil =
      total_soil -
      reused_soil
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Business-as-usual emissions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
#
# BAU means:
# all excavated soil goes through the 92 km disposal route.

trend <- trend %>%
  mutate(
    
    bau_emissions =
      total_soil *
      landfill_distance *
      emission_factor / 1000
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. ReGround emissions
# ---------------------------------------------------------

trend <- trend %>%
  mutate(
    
    reuse_emissions =
      reused_soil *
      reuse_distance *
      emission_factor / 1000,
    
    landfill_emissions =
      landfill_soil *
      landfill_distance *
      emission_factor / 1000,
    
    reground_emissions =
      reuse_emissions +
      landfill_emissions
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Calculate avoided emissions
# ---------------------------------------------------------

trend <- trend %>%
  mutate(
    
    emissions_saved =
      bau_emissions -
      reground_emissions,
    
    reduction_percent =
      emissions_saved /
      bau_emissions * 100
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. View full results
# ---------------------------------------------------------

print(trend)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7. 2035 summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------

summary_2035 <- trend %>%
  filter(year == 2035) %>%
  transmute(
    
    Year = year,
    
    `Projected soil generated (t/year)` =
      round(total_soil, 0),
    
    `ReGround share (%)` =
      round(reground_share * 100, 1),
    
    `Soil reused locally (t/year)` =
      round(reused_soil, 0),
    
    `Soil still landfilled (t/year)` =
      round(landfill_soil, 0),
    
    `BAU emissions (t CO2-e/year)` =
      round(bau_emissions, 1),
    
    `ReGround emissions (t CO2-e/year)` =
      round(reground_emissions, 1),
    
    `Emissions saved (t CO2-e/year)` =
      round(emissions_saved, 1),
    
    `Reduction (%)` =
      round(reduction_percent, 1)
  )

print(summary_2035)


# =========================================================
# 8. Graph: projected soil generation
# =========================================================

ggplot(
  trend,
  aes(
    x = year,
    y = total_soil
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Projected Auckland Excavated Soil Generation",
    subtitle = "Assuming 1.2% annual growth from 2026 to 2035",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Excavated soil (tonnes/year)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


# =========================================================
# 9. Graph: BAU vs ReGround emissions
# =========================================================

emission_plot <- trend %>%
  select(
    year,
    bau_emissions,
    reground_emissions
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      bau_emissions,
      reground_emissions
    ),
    names_to = "scenario",
    values_to = "emissions"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    scenario = recode(
      scenario,
      bau_emissions = "Business as usual",
      reground_emissions = "With ReGround"
    )
  )

ggplot(
  emission_plot,
  aes(
    x = year,
    y = emissions,
    linetype = scenario
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Projected Soil Transport Emissions to 2035",
    subtitle = "Business-as-usual compared with ReGround local reuse",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Transport emissions (tonnes CO2-e/year)",
    linetype = "Scenario"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


# =========================================================
# 10. Graph: annual emissions avoided
# =========================================================

ggplot(
  trend,
  aes(
    x = year,
    y = emissions_saved
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Projected Annual Emissions Avoided by ReGround",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Avoided emissions (tonnes CO2-e/year)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


# =========================================================
# 11. Graph: ReGround adoption
# =========================================================

ggplot(
  trend,
  aes(
    x = year,
    y = reground_share * 100
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = global_circular_target * 100,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "ReGround Adoption and Circular Material-Use Benchmark",
    subtitle = "15% is an external global benchmark, not an assumed ReGround target",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Percentage (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
